# Integrations (server)

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs` from the code. Edit the code comments, not this file. -->

The client's tools: read-only connectors, client workflows and client step checks, write-back and pipeline ingest tokens.

## Files

- `client-steps.ts`: v1.7.3: client steps on a use case.
- `connector-routes.ts`: Evidence connector API: set up read-only pulls from client systems, pull now, and see what each pull brought back.
- `connectors.ts`: Evidence connectors: read-only pulls from a client's systems.
- `ingest.ts`: v1.7.3: evidence pushed from CI/CD pipelines.
- `outbound.ts`: v1.7.3: write-back.
- `workflow-routes.ts`: Client workflows API (v1.7).
